data.description: Stores separately versioned canonical summary/protocol, idempotent handover notes, and project_memory_note_resolutions linking exact reviewed note ids to the resolving summary version and operation. Active reads exclude resolved notes; explicit retained-history retrieval preserves their original text, timestamps, run/task and operation provenance. Retention counts all notes including resolved history: at most 20 notes and 12,000 Unicode body characters, summary at most 4,000 and new notes at most 1,000. Expiring notes cascade their resolution metadata. Maintenance migrates exact old built-in protocols while preserving custom rules. Oversized legacy bodies become complete-boundary excerpts with explicit omission notices, never silent SQL clipping or invented semantic summaries. Receipts retain identity; replay cannot resurrect expired or stale bodies.
data.name: Project Memory Store
